# Unary Math Operations Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement the unary math family in `src/math/unary.rs`, covering numeric, real, complex, and bool-specific APIs exactly as documented.

**Architecture:** `unary.rs` owns all single-input element-wise semantic methods. Same-type operations share a common traversal skeleton; `modulus()` uses a separate output-type-changing path; `conjugate()` stays public under that exact name; and integer overflow remains panic-only.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `TensorBase`, `Tensor`, `Numeric`, `RealScalar`, `Complex`, `bool`

**Design Docs:** `design/11-math.md` §5.4, §5.5, §5.6, §5.7, §6.1, §10

**Prerequisites:** W15T1 must be complete.

---

- [ ] **Step 1: Add failing unary tests first**

Append the following tests to `tests/test_math.rs`:

```rust
#[test]
fn test_abs() {
    let tensor = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(3), vec![-3, 0, 5]).unwrap();
    let out = tensor.abs();
    assert_eq!(out.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![3, 0, 5]);
}

#[test]
fn test_not_bool() {
    let tensor = Tensor::<bool, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(3), vec![true, false, true]).unwrap();
    let out = tensor.not();
    assert_eq!(out.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![false, true, false]);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the complete unary implementation**

Create `src/math/unary.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::complex::Complex;
use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::{Numeric, RealScalar};
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::{Tensor, TensorBase};

fn apply_unary<A, D, S, F>(tensor: &TensorBase<S, D>, f: F) -> Tensor<A, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: Copy,
    F: Fn(A) -> A,
{
    unsafe { Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(tensor.iter().map(|&x| f(x)).collect(), tensor.raw_dim()) }
}

impl<S, D, A> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: Numeric + PartialOrd,
{
    pub fn abs(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> {
        apply_unary(self, |x| if x < A::zero() { -x } else { x })
    }
}

impl<S, D, A> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: Numeric,
{
    pub fn neg(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| -x) }
    pub fn square(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x * x) }
}

impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = i32>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn signum(&self) -> Tensor<i32, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.signum()) }
}
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = i64>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn signum(&self) -> Tensor<i64, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.signum()) }
}
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = f32>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn signum(&self) -> Tensor<f32, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.signum()) }
}
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = f64>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn signum(&self) -> Tensor<f64, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.signum()) }
}

impl<S, D, A> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: RealScalar,
{
    pub fn sin(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.sin()) }
    pub fn sqrt(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.sqrt()) }
    pub fn exp(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.exp()) }
    pub fn ln(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.ln()) }
    pub fn floor(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.floor()) }
    pub fn ceil(&self) -> Tensor<A, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.ceil()) }
}

impl<S, D, T> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = Complex<T>>,
    D: Dimension,
    T: RealScalar,
{
    pub fn modulus(&self) -> Tensor<T, D> {
        unsafe {
            Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(
                self.iter().map(|x| x.norm()).collect(),
                self.raw_dim(),
            )
        }
    }
}

impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = Complex<f32>>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn conjugate(&self) -> Tensor<Complex<f32>, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.conj()) }
}
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = Complex<f64>>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn conjugate(&self) -> Tensor<Complex<f64>, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| x.conj()) }
}
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D> where S: Storage<Elem = bool>, D: Dimension {
    pub fn not(&self) -> Tensor<bool, D> { apply_unary(self, |x| !x) }
}
```
